description: This Java class 'ExpressionUiHelper' provides utility methods for generating lists of date/time related options and labels, such as days of the week, months, frequency values, expression types, and candidate IDs for inclusion, used in UI components for temporal expressions within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ExpressionUiHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for generating date/time options and candidate IDs for UI components related to temporal expressions.

methods.name: getOccurrenceList
methods.description: Returns a list of valid DayInMonth occurrence integers, including positive and negative values.

methods.name: getDayValueList
methods.description: Returns a list of maps with descriptions and values for days of the week, localized according to the provided locale.

methods.name: getFirstDayOfWeek
methods.description: Returns the first day of the week for the specified locale.

methods.name: getLastDayOfWeek
methods.description: Returns the last day of the week for the specified locale.

methods.name: getMonthValueList
methods.description: Returns a list of maps with descriptions and values for months of the year, localized according to the provided locale.

methods.name: getFrequencyValueList
methods.description: Returns a list of maps with descriptions and values for frequency units (second, minute, hour, day, month, year) based on provided UI labels.

methods.name: getExpressionTypeList
methods.description: Returns a list of maps with descriptions and values for different temporal expression types, based on UI labels and expression types from TemporalExpressionWorker.

methods.name: getCandidateIncludeIds
methods.description: Returns a set of candidate temporal expression IDs for inclusion, excluding those already associated with the given tempExprId.
